messages:
Priya: HelmCo QBR prep — noticed a sharp rise in tokens after last week's sandbox push. Token runway for next 30d drops to ~60% if usage keeps this pace. Need a quick playbook for tomorrow's meeting. Who can own the enablement + spend mitigation notes?
Darren: I can take the spend mitigation piece. Will compute a conservative and optimistic 30d forecast. Can someone pull per-route token histograms so I can show which endpoints are hot?
Lena: I pulled logs earlier — embedding route accounts for ~55% of tokens last 7d. I'll attach a stripped-down CSV in the deck. Also recommend a short FAQ for customers about batching best practices.
Tom-CS: For enablement, I can run a 20-min session offer for power users and drop a one-pager on batching + prefix caching. Suggest we add a voluntary rate-limit toggle for heavy users for 2 weeks.
finance-bot: Alert: helmco acct_8120 projected 30d burn 62% (threshold warning). Sending invoice preview to helmco-finance@helmco.com.
Priya: Good. Action items: (A) Darren: 2 forecast scenarios + burn curve slide; (B) Lena: sanitized per-route CSV + short FAQ doc; (C) Tom-CS: enablement one-pager + session invite copy; (D) Priya: coordinate with AM on renewal speak track and mention temporary opt-in throttle. Can everyone ack and estimate ETA?
Darren: ack — will post the forecast slides by 11:30am PT.
Lena: ack :white_check_mark: FAQ and CSV in thread in 20m.
Tom-CS: ack :+1: enablement copy + session invite in 40m. I'll include a simple opt-in toggle mock and rollback instructions.
Priya: Also propose a small credit buffer (2% of expected 30d spend) to reduce friction for HelmCo during the ramp. @Darren can you compute the $ impact so AM can sign off?
Darren: Will calculate delta. Quick sample query I used to pull per-route tokens:
```
SELECT route, SUM(tokens) as total_tokens
FROM token_usage
WHERE account_id = 'acct_8120' AND ts >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY route
ORDER BY total_tokens DESC
LIMIT 10;
```
Lena: Throttle config suggestion for playbook:
```
# temporary opt-in per-customer throttle
customer.opt_in.throttle_window_days=14
customer.throttle.rate=0.6  # 60% of baseline
embed.batch_size=4
cache.kv_prefix_enabled=true
```
Tom-CS: I'll add a slide with the customer-facing language and the AM outreach cadence (three touches: email, 30-min session invite, follow-up two days later).
Priya: Perfect. I'll assemble the final QBR deck and share with AM + Sales by 3pm. Keeping thread here for sign-off — last update at 1736015690.
